headline: Türkiye Warns EU Against Excluding Turkish Auto Firms from 'Made in Europe' Rules
summary: Turkish Trade Minister Ömer Bolat stated that excluding Türkiye from proposed 'Made in Europe' regulations would harm the European automotive industry. He emphasized that Turkish component makers are deeply integrated into European vehicle supply chains.
why: Türkiye is a major manufacturing base for European vehicle components and commercial vehicles bound for the EU single market.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Exclusion from EU origin rules would disrupt Turkish automotive exports into European markets.
